SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM main."results" r
JOIN main."races" ra ON r."raceId" = ra."raceId"
JOIN main."constructors" c ON r."constructorId" = c."constructorId"
WHERE c."constructorRef" = 'brawn'
  AND ra."year" = 2009;
